sections.shortTitle: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XV OF 1985
ACT XV OF 1985
PAKISTAN INTERNATIONAL AIRLINES CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation
Act, 1956
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent the
President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for feral information
:-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Pakistan International Airlines
Corporation (Amendment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 25, Act XIX of 1956

ACT XV OF 1985
ACT XV OF 1985
PAKISTAN INTERNATIONAL AIRLINES CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation
Act, 1956
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent the
President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for feral information
:-
2. Amendment of section 25, Act XIX of 1956.---In the Pakistan national Airlines Corporation
Act, 1956 (XIX of 1956, in section 25, in sub-section (4), after the words
"Federal Government", the commas and words "whether by itself or
together with any financial institution, banking company, insurance corporation
or statutory corporation owned, managed controlled by it," shall be inserted.
